scope: Three main manuscript figures using saved aggregate scores and saved means only; no fitting, predictions, new uncertainty estimates, or native-data loads.

definitions.figure1: Primary 591-cell convex reference only. S: shared response; L: shared plus North/South response; C: shared plus gradual geographic response; CL: gradual plus North/South response. Every structure includes the geographic main effect. All six group-region held scores and saved equally weighted means; paired CL-C increments have their own x scale. Regions 1-3 correspond to saved folds 0-2.
definitions.figure2: All 168 fold/contrast/evaluation observations from the audited 84 fold contrasts: five units, equal and soft 10-km training weights, monthly minus variability and monthly minus non-nested full BIOCLIM, primary occupied-block and secondary occupied-cell evaluation. Diamonds are SAVED equal-fold means. Fold pairing lines are visual links, not intervals. Same x scale within each evaluation row; different scales between rows.
definitions.figure3: Left: water-minus-climate relative recording-density scores for fixed quadratic and shallow CatBoost controls in five source blocks; block 3 has only three records. Right: water-minus-terrestrial complete surveyed-history log-probability per cell, five source blocks; block 5 has five cells. Open symbols mark the sparse blocks. Diamonds are saved equal-block means. The two panels use different score definitions and x scales and must not be pooled.

automated_layout_check: All visible text at least 9 points, no text outside 6.5-inch canvas. Figures saved without tight-cropping so physical dimensions remain exact.

figures.figure1_controlled_responses: All 24 held scores, four means and six CL-C increments are visible. Structure labels, region symbols and separate panel scales are legible. Reduced gain-axis ticks remove label collision. No clipping or intervals.
figures.figure2_seasonal_representations: Label-only revision visually inspected: North/South labels replace prior taxonomic wording. Matched-fold connectors, all values, axes, means, colors and dimensions retained. No clipping.
figures.figure3_mapped_water: Separate density and history scales/units are explicit; both learner means and survey mean visible. Sparse blocks marked with open symbols and sample sizes. No clipping or intervals.

label_revision.scope: Figure 2 North/South display labels only; Figure 1 and Figure 3 remain byte-identical to prior completed versions.
